result.explanation: Retain snapshots in oldest-to-newest order. Saving an existing ID removes its prior snapshot, appends the new snapshot, and trims the oldest entries beyond keep. Damage changes only a valid stored data element and leaves its checksum unchanged. Restore scans retained snapshots newest-first, recomputes the specified checksum modulo 251, and returns a copied data array from the first match; all other events return null data and chosen values.
